description: Perfect-reward rest environments for nine chapters. Preserve existing clothing except the fox's ivory cotton fundoshi-style wrap and the wolf's added fur blanket. Chapter 3 retains its approved v14 home scene. Gameplay main plates, masks, seals, portraits and face bounds are unchanged.

settings.1: A rustic branch-and-bark shelter by the forest lake; original brown shorts with an added fur blanket for warmth.
settings.2: A sandstone sitting room with linen cushions and an oasis window.
settings.4: A private castle library with a velvet chaise and fireplace.
settings.5: An autumn farmhouse living room; the horse remains outside the window.
settings.6: A coastal home with a cushioned nautical sofa and moonlit sea view.
settings.7: A private tatami room; ivory cotton fundoshi-style waist ties and a broad front panel, retaining the corrected foreground knee.
settings.8: A northern lodge with a warm hearth and aurora view.
settings.9: A belfry reading room with a sofa that accommodates the wings.
settings.10: A quiet obsidian living room with a small enclosed hearth.
